title: Affinity board for usability observations

provenance.origin: Written for the AstaUI prototype; not a real participant's work.

notes: Thirty invented observation notes from six usability sessions (P01 to P06) on a transit trip planner prototype. Two clusters are already started so the theme list is not empty. A note belongs to whichever cluster its centre sits inside, so membership always matches what is on the board. The board lives in memory only and is lost on reload; the Markdown export is the record.
